each case target carries the post-qualification field its own probe covers, not all eight: the set proves a candidate cannot omit a field, and exhibits no complete seventeen-field manifest (run 20260809T021408Z-benchmaker-unseal)

the qualifying contexts' model id, effort and host binding were not recorded either, so builder/qualifier disjointness is asserted by qualification/index.md's own header and computable from no field on this set; a later revision that records both halves is what makes it computable
incomparability: A score is a property of target x model x harness x benchmark. Scores do not cross this benchmark revision, nor a change of model id, effort level, host binding or scaffold. No harness offset is subtracted: the effect is candidate-dependent, so one correction term is wrong for every candidate but one. A claim spanning the boundary re-runs every retained candidate and reports paired per-case verdicts and the count of sign flips, never a rank correlation over two candidates.
